units.base_error: N.m (error x RMS of its training regressor column)
units.extras: fv N.m.s/rad, fs N.m, Ia kg.m^2

settings.common_objective: J = ||W(Y theta - tau)||^2 + lam||(theta-theta0)/s||^2; lam = PhysicalPolicy.prior_weight, theta0 = nominal URDF, s = comparator coord_scale; reported as data + reg for every method
settings.frozen_extra: fv, fs, Ia fixed at 0 (= truth)
settings.joint_extra: independent extras estimated with theta (variable projection); extras collinear with the inertial base are absorbed and listed per case
settings.cross_check: cvxopt vs QICS on the first seed of every noise/weighting cell, both modes
